content.comment_body: Hello. I am attempting to connect to a [product_name] device with model [article_no] using [product_name] software. The device product number is [article_no]. The firmware/software version is [product_name] V[version_no]. I am able to download, but I cannot go online due to a hardware version mismatch. In the software, I have the type [article_no], whereas the actual hardware is [article_no], and this type does not appear in the hardware selections. I cannot locate any hardware configuration file for this software. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you.

Welcome to the forum. There are different hardware versions of the [product_name] module: [article_no].Standard and [article_no].ES4. These options can be found under: Tools > Select Hardware. This opens a configuration window where you can choose the correct hardware type (refer to the attachment). To view the firmware version: Tools > Transfer > Show Firmware Version.
Thank you for your response. That addressed the issue, it was my own mistake. I had selected ES instead of Standard.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced difficulties connecting to a [product_name] device with [product_name] software due to a mismatch between the hardware version in the software and the actual device. The conversation illustrates how choosing the correct hardware type in the software configuration can be challenging if hardware versions are unclear, leading to connection issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a straightforward and clear method to select the correct hardware version within [product_name] software, as well as better identification of hardware variants to enable smooth connection to the device.
